name: Attached-lid container 600 x 400 x 415 mm
description:
An attached-lid container (ALC), also called a distribution tote or a swan-neck crate, on the standard 600 x 400 mm euro footprint - four per 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer. ALCs are the workhorse of retail distribution, returnable transit packaging and internal transfer, because the lid travels with the box and cannot be lost.

External dimensions: length 600 mm, width 400 mm, height 415 mm.

600 x 400 mm footprint: the standard euro container module, four per 1200 x 800 mm Euro pallet layer.

GLB (glTF 2.0), real-world scale in metres, origin at the centre of the base. 2,548 triangles, flat PBR base colours, no textures. CC BY 4.0.
summary: Attached-lid container, 600 x 400 x 415 mm - true-scale GLB of a standard euro-footprint distribution tote with an integral hinged lid.
